name: Lamborghini.com
summary: A hard-edged automotive showroom style built from pure black, white, one yellow action color, uppercase condensed typography, zero-radius geometry, full-bleed car imagery, black navigation, spec strips, and sharp editorial sections.

typography.fallback: Arial Narrow, Inter Condensed, Helvetica Neue Condensed, Arial

layout.model: full-bleed automotive media, black product bands, edge-to-edge spec strips, and square editorial grids

elevation.gradients: black image overlays only when required for text legibility
elevation.depth: photography, scale, contrast, and hard section breaks

dos: Use uppercase condensed typography for nav, CTAs, labels, and major product names.
Use 0px radius on every functional and media element.
Reserve Giallo for the most important action and small active accents.
Let real automotive imagery or video carry the emotional weight.
Use silver for secondary labels, captions, metadata, and inactive states.
Organize pages with black product sections and white or concrete editorial bands.
donts: Do not add soft shadows, glow effects, or decorative blur backgrounds.
Do not introduce pastel support colors or extra accent hues.
Do not build the page as nested SaaS cards.
Do not use lowercase navigation or CTA labels.
Do not replace product media with abstract illustrations.
